textwithimage.text:
Based on TQMa117xL

The Embedded Starterkit STKa117xL is an industrial-grade evaluation kit centered around the TQMa117xL embedded module. It harnesses the power of NXP's i.MX RT1170 series, featuring the Arm® Cortex®-M7 processor, for robust and versatile embedded computing applications. With capabilities to deliver up to WXGA resolution at 60 fps and a comprehensive set of interfaces including CAN FD, Analog Frontend, Digital IN/OUT, WiFi, Mobile Network, Gbit Ethernet with TSN/AVB, and USB 2.0, it provides engineers with a flexible platform for a wide range of industrial tasks.

This kit emphasizes energy efficiency, boasting low power consumption at just 1W, and integrates essential security functions for data protection. In collaboration with NXP as a hardware partner, it ensures reliability and performance. With dimensions suited for industrial use, along with OS support for Free RTOS, the STKa117xL is an invaluable tool for embedded computing engineers seeking practical solutions for real-world applications

text.text:
Features

  • High-Resolution Display Support: Capable of delivering up to WXGA (1280x800) resolution at 60 fps.
  • Comprehensive Interface Set: Includes 2x CAN FD, Analog Frontend, Digital IN/OUT, WiFi, Mobile Network, Gbit Ethernet with TSN/AVB, and USB 2.0 interfaces.
  • Energy-Efficient Operation: Operates with low typical power consumption of 1W.
  • Integrated Security Functions: Incorporates essential security features to safeguard data.
  • Reliable Hardware Partner: Developed in collaboration with NXP, ensuring reliability and performance in industrial applications

  • STKa1176L (Eval Kit) with TQMa1176L-AA, Cortex®-M7/800 MHz, Cortex® M4/400 MHz, 64 MB NOR Flash, 32 MB SDRAM, 64 kB EEPROM, RTC, 2x USB 2.0 HOST, 2x ETH 10/100/1000, 2x CAN FD, 1x RS485, 1x LVDS or 1x MIPI-DSI, 1x MIPI CSI, 1x Temperature sensor, GPIOs (4x 24V_IN, 4x 24V_OUT, 8x AI_IN), Reset-Button, SD Card interface, WiFi, IoT Mobile Network, Power Supply, 4 GB SD card, Cables

Starterkit STKa117xxL set
  • The core of the STKa117xL set is the TQMa117xL module with a Cortex®-M7 CPU. The components contained in the starter kit constitute a modular system enabling you to develop your own product ideas. Development of graphic interfaces can be started immediately using the prepared combination of closed display unit and starter kit that are matched to each other. To develop your own hardware you can use the certified and qualified circuit components of the starter kit in your own designs.
